objectives: Practical AI development often involves the use of C/C++, Python, or a combination of both to achieve high system performance and development efficiency. The objective of this course is to help learners build a solid foundation in C/C++ and Python programming, and to strengthen their practical application skills through a semester-long course project that integrates and applies course knowledge.
